**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

§ 8.2–8.3 already deliver the full preferred bargain: 12-month automatic renewal terms, a 30-day Customer non-renewal notice window (extended if Vendor misses its reminder), a mandatory Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal, and renewal uplifts capped at the lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. No other renewal or uplift language appears in the document, so no redline is proposed.
